primitives.name: Line Advancement Dynamics
primitives.verbatim_quote: If nowadays an advancing line does not always lead directly to a touchdown by rushing, it always makes opportunities and generally ruins the opposing attack.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'L(t)': 'Line position at time t (meters)', 'T(t)': 'Touchdown potential at time t (dimensionless)', 'A(t)': 'Attack opportunity at time t (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Linear progression of line movement implies proportional increase in attack efficacy and opponent disruption.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When L(t) remains static or reverses direction, A(t) approaches zero and T(t) decreases.

layer2.mapping: State transition function f(L(t)) → (T(t), A(t)) models how line motion affects game state.
layer2.telemetry: Scrimmage displacement rate and opponent tackle efficiency

primitives.name: Line Position Outcome Correlation
primitives.verbatim_quote: If the line goes forward the team wins, if the line comes back the team loses.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'W(t)': 'Win probability at time t (dimensionless)', 'L(t)': 'Line position at time t (meters)'}
primitives.assumptions: Binary outcome correlation between line advancement and team success.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When L(t) < 0, W(t) < 0.5; when L(t) > 0, W(t) > 0.5.

layer2.mapping: Boolean mapping of line displacement to win/loss probability via threshold function.
layer2.telemetry: Net yardage differential and turnover events

primitives.name: Fight Intensity Spirit
primitives.verbatim_quote: Above all, the line men must be imbued with a spirit of punishing fight.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F(t)': 'Fight intensity at time t (arbitrary units)', 'S(t)': 'Spirit level at time t (dimensionless)'}
primitives.assumptions: Fight intensity is a latent variable modulated by spirit and sustained over time.
primitives.breakdown_regime: F(t) decays exponentially without S(t) reinforcement.

layer2.mapping: Dynamic feedback loop F(t) = g(S(t)) × h(time) models persistent aggression.
layer2.telemetry: Tackle frequency, penalty data, and stamina metrics

reasoning_traces.think:
The core insight is that line behavior operates under a deterministic yet dynamic framework where advancement correlates with outcome. The first primitive establishes a functional relationship between line motion and strategic opportunity generation. The second encodes a binary outcome model based on net displacement. The third introduces a motivational kernel that sustains effort. These form a triadic system: motion generates opportunity, opportunity influences outcome, and motivation sustains motion. Failure modes include static line positions (no progress), loss of spirit (decreased fight intensity), and misalignment of focus (e.g., watching opponent instead of ball). Dualities emerge in the opposition between forward/backward motion and the duality of skill vs. raw effort. The system exhibits non-linear feedback loops through spirit-driven persistence and strategic disruption.
